objective_summary: Decide whether daily maximum temperature and public holidays measurably raise Valdena Gelato's daily ice-cream sales, so the owner can plan weekly orders. The discovery must confirm that daily sales history for 2023-06-01 to 2026-03-31 exists at product level, that product codes can be bridged across the 2024 code change, and that weather and holiday covariates can be linked by date for a justified Italian location. Output feeds a feasibility decision, not a production forecast yet.

need_plans.interpretation: Daily ice-cream unit and/or revenue sales per product (SKU/product code) for the shop, covering history 2023-06-01 to 2025-05-31 and recent 2025-06-01 to 2026-03-31, at daily grain, with a date key and product key.
internal_queries: ice cream POS sales daily export
gelato sales transactions per day SKU
acceptance_criteria: Daily grain confirmed for every day in history and recent windows, or gaps listed explicitly
Product key present and stable enough to group products
Quantity and/or revenue field identified with unit definition
No customer-level identifiers required or present in extracted fields
Coverage gaps (closed days, outages, missing days) quantified
likely_pitfalls: Product codes changed in 2024; history and recent may not join without N2 mapping
Sales recorded at transaction or receipt level and not aggregated to day; timezone/cut-off errors
Refunds, voids and discounts mixed into quantity
Closed days absent rather than zero, biasing averages
Renamed or migrated tables between POS system versions

need_plans.interpretation: A static mapping table from pre-2024 product codes to post-change codes (one-to-one, one-to-many or retired), with effective dates, so that products can be compared across the 2024 code change.
internal_queries: SKU migration old codes new codes
acceptance_criteria: Mapping covers every product sold in 2023-06-01 to 2025-05-31
Each old code maps to a new code, or is explicitly flagged as retired/unmatched
Effective date of the change recorded
Products with no clean match are listed so they can be excluded from cross-period comparison
likely_pitfalls: Mapping exists only in a wiki page and not as a table, or is out of date
Many-to-one merges (two flavours merged) break product-level comparison
Product renamed without code change, or code reused for a different product
Mapping authored by a person without a version or date

need_plans.interpretation: Daily maximum air temperature (degrees Celsius) for a justified location in northern Italy, covering 2023-06-01 to 2026-03-31 at daily grain, keyed on calendar date.
internal_queries: climate data city Italy daily max
external_data_hints: Use the register Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis); request daily temperature_2m_max at a location justified in decisions.md (for example a city in northern Italy near the shop region); timezone set to Europe/Rome; confirm the reanalysis covers the full window.
acceptance_criteria: Daily max temperature present for every date in both windows, no gaps
Units in degrees Celsius confirmed
Location coordinates recorded as an assumption in decisions.md
Timezone and daily aggregation (local day vs UTC) documented
likely_pitfalls: Reanalysis is modelled data, not station observations; document this
Using UTC day boundaries shifts the daily max relative to local sales days
Probe ranges should be kept short; do not bulk download beyond needed window
Location assumption not stated, so the effect size cannot be reproduced

need_plans.interpretation: A list of public holidays in Italy by date for 2023 through 2026, at daily grain, with national and regional flags, to flag holiday days in both windows.
acceptance_criteria: Every date in both windows is covered for years 2023 to 2026 (Nager call per year and country IT)
National holidays confirmed; regional or local holidays (e.g. patron saint days) flagged as gaps unless sourced
Holiday names and dates checked against an official Italian source for at least a sample
Country code IT used
likely_pitfalls: Nager returns national holidays only; local patron-day holidays and Ferragosto-related closures may be missing
Shop may close on some holidays, so holiday flag is not the same as trading day
Year-specific Easter-based dates must be checked, not assumed

need_plans.interpretation: Shop opening days (trading calendar, closures, hours changes) and local events near the shop (fairs, festivals, sea or lake events) at daily grain across both windows.
external_data_hints: If local events are needed, a municipal events calendar or regional tourism portal for the chosen town (open-data portal, daily or event grain, 2023-2026) could be linked; check terms and that it names the same town as the weather location.
acceptance_criteria: Opening/closing status known for every day in both windows, or unknowns listed
Source of the trading calendar named and dated
Any event source names the same municipality as the weather location
Events are only used if they are dated and sourced
likely_pitfalls: Opening days stored as a roster not a trading log, so closures are missing
Events calendars are often incomplete or published after the fact
Local events may be confounded with holidays and heat

open_questions: Which northern Italian city should be the weather location for Valdena Gelato (the shop's city is not named in any source)? Please confirm and record in decisions.md.
Does the shop record revenue, units, or both, and is a sales day defined by a local cut-off?
Does the shop close on any national holidays, and on which regional or patron-saint days?
Is there a written or system record of the 2024 product code change, and who owns it?
Is there a sales gap between 2025-05-31 and 2025-06-01, or any closure period in the recent window, that should be excluded?
Should local events be in scope at all, given that no register source covers them and a municipal source would need a separate licence check?
